item: A) VERIFIER CHECKS (binary Pass/Fail) — from the golden set
V1 [auto/mandatory/K1] All 12 deliverables are present (6 transparent PNGs + 6 white-bg JPEGs, one pair per SKU).
definition / pass_condition: A transparent PNG AND a 3000x3000 white-bg JPEG exist for each of sku01–sku06 (12 files); any missing file fails.

item: V2 [auto/mandatory/K1] Each white-background JPEG is exactly 3000x3000 px.
definition / pass_condition: The 6 white-bg JPEGs each measure exactly 3000x3000 px; any other dimension fails.

item: V3 [auto/mandatory/K1] Transparent PNGs have real alpha transparency (background actually removed).
definition / pass_condition: Each isolated PNG has an alpha channel with the area around the piece fully transparent; a flattened/opaque PNG or one still carrying the backdrop fails.

item: V4 [auto/mandatory/K1] The white background is pure #FFFFFF with no shadow and no leftover clutter.
definition / pass_condition: On each white-bg JPEG, pixels sampled off the piece read #FFFFFF (255,255,255) with no cast shadow, grey sweep, or prop visible; any off-white, shadow, or clutter fails. (Hard brand constraint.)

item: V5 [expert/mandatory/K3] Clean isolation edges — no halo/fringe, and nothing chopped (bail, prongs, clasp, thin links intact).
definition / pass_condition: Every piece has a clean cut edge with no halo/matte fringe/jaggies AND no missing/clipped parts; haloing or an eaten prong/clasp/link fails.

item: V6 [expert/mandatory/K3] Fine open detail is preserved: filigree gaps, chain-link gaps and prong gaps are cut through to the background.
definition / pass_condition: On the filigree pendant, chain bracelet, earrings and rings the interior open gaps read as background (transparent/white), not filled solid; any blocked/filled gap fails.

item: V7 [expert/mandatory/K4] The silver reads bright, cool-neutral and crisp — colour cast removed and exposure lifted.
definition / pass_condition: Across all six the metal is neutral silver (no warm/yellow or cool/blue cast, correcting sku01 warm + sku02 cool) and bright/crisp rather than dull/muddy; a residual cast or flat muddy result fails.

item: V8 [expert/mandatory/K3] Oxidised cuff (sku05): antique dark recess detail is held (blacks not crushed).
definition / pass_condition: sku05's oxidised recesses keep visible detail while the raised metal reads bright; crushed solid-black recesses fail.

item: V9 [expert/mandatory/K3] Each piece is straightened and level.
definition / pass_condition: Every piece sits straight/level versus the tilted source frames; a noticeably tilted piece fails.

item: V10 [expert/mandatory/K4] All six read as one matched catalog set (consistent brightness, neutrality, finish).
definition / pass_condition: The six look like one consistent catalog, not six different edits; a visibly odd-one-out SKU fails. (Core requirement.)

item: V11 [expert/mandatory/K2] Each output is the real supplied piece, isolated — not regenerated, substituted, or reshaped.
definition / pass_condition: Each deliverable is clearly the cleaned/isolated version of its supplied SKU (same piece, same form); a regenerated, reshaped, or substituted piece fails.

item: V12 [expert/dealbreaker/K7] No generative or out-of-scope editing was used.
definition / pass_condition: No generative fill/expand, no AI object add/remove-with-reconstruction, no upscaling beyond source, no compositing; the white background is a solid #FFFFFF fill (not generative). Any generative artifact fails.
